Rock On 48 Ultimate Rockin Collection Mineral Specimens Set Guide Tray
Department:
Collectibles & Art
Condition:
Used
Category:

Description:
Bring home an exciting educational experience with this 48-piece rock and mineral collection kit. The set includes an original display box, a blue plastic tray with 48 slots (a few may be missing stones), and a colorful fold-out poster with vivid images and information for each rock and mineral featured in the collection. Included are a variety of polished and raw stones, from classic rose quartz to unique textured specimens and a heart-shaped clear stone. The kit offers a wonderful visual and tactile variety for collectors, students, or those curious about geology. Each item is photographed to display its specific characteristics, while the included guide enhances learning and identification for each stone. The set as shown is in used condition with some stones potentially missing and visible wear to the packaging. Perfect for an educational gift, a hands-on science tool, or a starter set for amateur collectors

278046436.description:
Natural Mineral & Sea Shell Specimen Lot
Mixed Geological and Marine Collection
Diverse specimens including Quartz, Rose Quartz, and Tumbled Stones
This collection features various natural geological and marine specimens, highlighted by a substantial crystalline quartz block showing translucent blue-grey formations. The lot includes raw minerals, aura-treated crystal points, and assorted tumbled gemstones alongside diverse sea shell species, offering a representation of natural forms suitable for study or display.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Large Crystalline Quartz Block
- Specimen with druzy surfaces, approx. 6" wide
2.
Raw Rose Quartz
- Natural chunk with pink coloration
3.
Aura Coated Crystal Points
- Iridescent pink and yellow-orange specimens
4.
Tumbled Gemstones
- Includes Tigers Eye, Sodalite, and various jaspers
5.
Natural Sea Shells
- Mixed varieties including mussels and cockles
6.
Mineral Fragments
- Small clusters of clear druzy quartz
Condition:
Good condition for natural specimens. Large quartz block shows natural matrix and surface sediment. Tumbled stones are polished and smooth. Shells include both whole pieces and natural fragments. Total lot weight is 8 pounds.
Thank you for all of your support!
